description: Goblins are stumpy humanoids with large bodies, scrawny limbs, and massively oversized heads with large ears and beady red eyes.

features.name: Goblin Scuttle / Bite
features.tldr: You possess sharp teeth for an unarmed attack and move rapidly when allies shift.
